Henrik Rasmussen is mentioned in the corpus as a substitute medical consultant (lægefaglig konsulent) for the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK), representing the organization DAK-E [^src1]. Because the available data is thin, no further biographical details, timeline events, or specific claims are documented about him beyond this administrative and advisory role.

His affiliation is listed within the steering group composition of the AFDK annual report covering the period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023 [^src1]. This report, published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), serves as a foundational document for clinical and political decision-making in Danish cardiovascular health, detailing data validity, coverage limitations, and mortality statistics [^src1]. Rasmussen's position as a DAK-E representative highlights the structural collaboration between general practice quality databases and specialized national clinical registries in Denmark [^src1].
